## The Road to Success Podcast®


On this episode of *The Road to Success* ® podcast, we are highlighting ways safety programs can strengthen your transportation logistics business. Landstar independent freight agents share how safety programs help grow their businesses, reduce inefficiencies and build loyal customers.


> “We want and expect every other company on the road to be safe, because our families are out there. And that's what motivated me to get involved with safety.”
> – Chris Dale,
> Little John Transportation Services
> Independent Landstar Agent


#### *Tune into other episodes of The Road to Success® podcast by*[visiting our podcast channel](http://roadtosuccess.libsyn.com/) *or subscribe wherever you listen to your favorite podcasts.*
